description.zh:
监播输出流的App。
名称可自取，不传默认用**monitor**作为AppName名称。
description.en: The application name for the output stream of the monitoring session. You can specify a custom name. If you do not specify this parameter, **monitor** is used as the AppName.

description.zh: 支持输入HTTP(S)格式的回调地址。
description.en: The webhook address. HTTP and HTTPS are supported.

description.zh:
监播钉钉告警通过钉群机器人进行告警信息的通知，请先设置钉群机器人，并在此输入机器人的HTTP(S)地址。详情请参见[自定义机器人接入](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access)。

> 配置钉群机器人自定义关键词为“告警”，否则消息无法接收。
description.en:
The webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot. Monitoring alerts are sent to a DingTalk group using a chatbot. Set up a chatbot and enter its webhook URL, which must be an HTTP or HTTPS address. For more information, see [Custom robot access](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/robots/custom-robot-access).

> Set the custom keyword of the DingTalk chatbot to "Alerting". Otherwise, messages cannot be received.
The output domain name for the monitoring session.

description.zh: 监控流输入列表。具体内容，请参考下表**InputConfig**。
description.en: The list of input streams to monitor. For more information, see the **InputConfig** table below.

description.zh: 监播告警阈值设置，JSON格式，具体内容，请参考下表MonitorConfig。
description.en: The settings for alert thresholds. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see the MonitorConfig table below.

description.zh:
监播室ID。
>通过查看[CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~)接口的返回参数获取MonitorId值。
description.en:
The ID of the monitoring session.

> Obtain the MonitorId value from the response parameters of the [CreateLiveStreamMonitor](~~2848129~~) operation.
The name of the monitoring session.

description.zh:
监播输出模版。类型取值：

- **lp_ld**：流畅。
- **lp_sd**：标清。
- **lp_hd**：高清。
- **lp_ud**：超清。
description.en:
The output template for the monitoring session. Valid values:

- **lp\_ld**: low definition.

- **lp\_sd**: standard definition.

- **lp\_hd**: high definition.

- **lp\_ud**: ultra-high definition.
The name of the output stream for the monitoring session.

descriptions.zh:
此接口针对监播室配置进行更新，监播室在启动状态下对输入源配置更新可实时生效。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation updates the configuration of a monitoring session. If the monitoring session is running, updates to the input source configuration take effect in real time.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 10. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled. Throttling can affect your business, so we recommend that you plan your calls accordingly.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-stream-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --monitor-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --monitor-name liveMonitor0000 --domain demo.aliyundoc.com --app monitor0000 --stream monitorStream0000 --output-template lp_ud --input-list InputConfig --monitor-config fpsLowThres_:_0.6,_brLowThres_:_1.1,_eofDurationThresSec_:_10 --callback-url http://guide.aliyundoc.com/notify --ding-talk-web-hook-url https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=7a7d404056eee1f2fd944ace9bcfc361dc6448583e1d3d3baa0000 --region cn-hangzhou
